annotations.title: Verify an AI crawler's IP address

description: Check whether an IP address really belongs to an AI or search crawler (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Bingbot, Applebot, Amazonbot) using the vendors' published IP lists (refreshed daily) and reverse DNS. Use this when someone sees a crawler in server logs or analytics and wants to know whether it is real or a fake user agent; pass the log line's user agent to check the claim.

ip.description: The visitor's IP address (IPv4 or IPv6)

user_agent.description: The user agent from the same log line, to check which crawler it claims to be

name: verify_crawler_ip
title: Verify an AI crawler's IP address
